name: Vevor DTX Weather Station
description: The `vevor_dtx` component decodes the internal DTX data signal used by some Vevor 7-in-1 weather station receiver displays. It is intended for installations where an ESP is connected to the receiver board data signal, rather than receiving the outdoor sensor's RF transmission directly.

config_entries.label: Receiver ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [Remote Receiver](https://esphome.io/components/remote_receiver/) connected to the DTX signal. Required when more than one receiver is configured.

config_entries.label: Bit Time
config_entries.description: Expected DTX bit timing. Defaults to `88us`.

config_entries.label: Station ID
config_entries.description: Only decode frames from the outdoor station with this ID, so a neighbour's station cannot overwrite the readings. Read the ID of your station from the `sensor_id` text sensor first, then set it here, for example `station_id: 0x1234`. Defaults to accepting every station.
